recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：未 gate 的細胞中，紅色主族群 CD33 陽性、細胞質 MPO 由陰性延伸到強陽性，棕色族群 MPO 強陽性但 CD33 弱或陰性（成熟顆粒球），紫色族群兩者皆陰性（淋巴球）。
features: Ungated flow cytometry dot plot: cytoplasmic MPO-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Dominant red-colored population with moderate CD33 and MPO ranging from negative to bright
Brown-colored population with bright MPO and dim-to-negative CD33, consistent with maturing granulocytes
Purple/grey events negative for both markers, consistent with lymphocytes and other non-myeloid cells
describe_en: Ungated flow cytometric analysis plotting cytoplasmic MPO against CD33 shows a dominant CD33-positive population (colored red, presumably the blast gate) with heterogeneous MPO expression spanning negative to bright. A separate brown population with bright MPO and dim-to-negative CD33 represents maturing granulocytes, and double-negative purple events represent lymphocytes. The cytoplasmic MPO expression in a subset of CD33-positive cells confirms myeloid lineage of the abnormal population in this GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm; color-to-gate assignments should be confirmed against the full gating strategy.
